rubric_notes: Complete and well-supported: release stated, full lineage with sunids, all four curated families plus a.22.1.0, complete TAF family membership, archaeal species nodes incl. Methanopyrus kandleri (68988 in bundle), bacterial hypotheticals. Superfamily = probable common ancestry, not shared function or family; explicitly refuses to assign nucleosome packaging, DNA binding or TAF/NF-Y function from placement. H1/H5 treated as a placement difference, not non-homology; name-only hits and j.63 peptide handled. Limits on pagination, periodic update, and absence of alignments stated. Minor odd wording 'fold letters differ'. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. Release scope stated, full lineages with sunids verified, superfamily identified as deepest shared homology node, no family-level claim, no quantification overreach. Rejects HisE activity/substrate/pathway transfer, residue or ligand correspondence, template interchange, and explicitly says calling the domains analogs or convergent would be wrong. Lists external evidence needed. Complete.

Correct families c.55.1.1/.3/.4 with sunids and protein nodes, full lineage to c.55/c, superfamily and family homology records all supported. States superfamily as the homology-bearing level, remote common ancestry, no family-level claim, and rejects substrate/reaction/role/template transfer. Search-fallback note ('glycerol' vs 'glycerol kinase') supported. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. Fully verified hierarchy, sunids, homology flags, Pfam mapping, R1 exclusion, release/periodic labels all supported by bundle. Interpretation correct: positive homology only at superfamily level, family split records divergence, different chemistry must not be read as convergence; chemistry labelled as literature not API. Weak on the third must_include: notes the API lacks alignments/residue correspondence but does not state that metal-ligand, reaction, assembly or role claims require family-specific experimental/biochemical evidence.

Complete and fully supported: all three families under b.6.1 with sunids, example domains (d1dyza_, d1iuza_, d1wd8a2), superfamily copper comment versus family 'lacking the metal-binding site' comments with Pfam mappings, homology responses without warnings. Interprets superfamily as remote probable common ancestry, rejects copper and electron-transfer inference, and states that no alignment, residue correspondence or metal-site check was retrieved. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Superfamily d.15.1 in fold d.15 with three families, sunids and homology scopes supported; superfamily-level probable common ancestry, not family-level; rejects conjugation and Ras-GTP transfers; name-collision caveats for UBX (c.47.1.24, a.5.2.1, a.4.1.1) and Raf (g.49.1.1, d.144.1.7) supported by search results; p97/Ras functions flagged as pretrained knowledge needing citation; limits stated. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Evaluator claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22. Complete verified lineage (families c.23.1.1/c.23.1.4/c.23.1.5, superfamily c.23.1, fold c.23) with sunids and empty homology warnings; superfamily read as probable common ancestry, fold as structural only. Uses retrieved 'lacks canonical receiver domains features' and Pfam PF03709 annotations correctly, retrieves the ODC major domain c.67.1.5 lineage under c.67 to reject wing catalysis, and rejects CheY phosphorylation and KaiA circadian transfer, convergence claims, and boundary claims. Limits honestly stated.

Complete hierarchy with sunids for fold, all five superfamilies, family and protein nodes; homology records cited correctly. Interpretation: superfamily placement asserts common origin among b.84.5; only fold-level architecture shared with b.84.1-b.84.4; explicitly no claim of non-relation; function and template transfer rejected; needed external evidence named. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct f.21 fold and three superfamilies with sunids and f.21.3.1 family, bundle-supported. Clearly separates fold-level similarity from superfamily homology, states the hierarchy neither proves relatedness nor independent origin, and specifies that sequence/structural alignment with residue correspondence would be needed. Honestly lists what was not retrieved (annotations, homology records, f.21.1 children); the possible-link note is therefore absent but limits are stated. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

All identifiers, lineage, homology scopes, annotations (N-terminal comment, PF02254), and search behaviour supported by bundle. Reads c.2.1 as remote superfamily-level homology of a Rossmann scaffold, not family-level closeness; treats family labels as context names rather than per-member function; forbids transfer of substrate, cofactor, reaction, oligomeric state, pathway role, or template; notes absence of warnings is not proof. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Accurate same-family placement (k.40.1.1, SUNID 100905) and identifiers, with good function-transfer and design-lineage caveats. It even notes the API was not checked for whether this is a 'true' family, but never queried the family node, so the explicit 'not a true family' annotation is absent and the answer frames the placement as SCOPe asserting homology. Decisive annotation ignored; bio capped at 2, factual 2. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Complete lineages for both domains in both releases with correct sunids and SCCS; d1t1ja_ (1.69) vs d1t1ja1 A:1-118 (2.08); families c.23.14.2 vs c.23.14.1 under shared c.23.14. Interprets the change as reclassification into superfamily-level homologs, not same family, with explicit refusal of functional inference; notes boundary differences, tag domain, and that the API gives no rationale or timing. Fully bundle-supported. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Full artifact lineage with sunid and SCCS, homology warning cited and supported by bundle; d1a14h1 H:9-111 b.1.1.1 VH identified from parents endpoint. Explicitly rejects function/template/family transfer from tag similarity and notes shared l.1.1.1 placement reflects artificial sequence not ancestry. Clear limits on unknown tag sequence. Complete.

Complete: single domain 1.75/2.01-2.03, split first appearing in 2.04 and persisting to 2.08 into f.60.1.1 and b.179.1.1 with full lineages. Clear domain-architecture inference, no superfamily homology asserted between modules, and detailed release-matched search guidance. Bundle supports the release series and annotations.

Correct five-domain assignments with SIDs and boundaries; d.394 single-member fold for a5 identified as the structurally distinct new module; a1-a4 placed in established superfamilies with a4 the only family-level link; uses fold homology warning and comment; limits on ancestry vs function, no alignment evidence, periodic update not queried. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Complete: shared family, repeat-count-driven length, and explicit 're' heterogeneity plus 4cj9 A:259-292 representative repeat. Precisely notes d4cj9a_ lacks the 're' flag and that per-domain repeat counts are unverified hypotheses, respecting must_avoid. Lineage, lengths, annotations, and homology all backed by a comprehensive bundle; periodic-update caveat is appropriate.

Correct release metadata (2.08, 2.08-stable, 2021-07-28 freeze, 2021-09-22 release, periodic 2.08-2026-08-16) all supported by the bundle. Cites stable 2.08 and the release-scoped path as the reproducibility basis and says periodic updates do not replace stable releases. Explicitly declines to state what periodic updates contain, so the required semantics (new PDB entries added without rewriting older domains) is missing; guidance on preserving the dated label for periodic-only entries is only implicit. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

All classifications, sunids, fragment comment, 'ms' flags, automated-match provenance and the d3c98b_ reference record are correct and bundle-supported. Correctly scopes the fragment placements to a three-helical subregion, identifies 1dn1 B as the full-domain reference, distinguishes provenance from quality, and treats the spectrin comment as a structural remark. Does not mention 1dn1's obsolescence and does not state that the complete domain resolves the fragment-driven resemblance. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. Five folds across three classes correctly enumerated and all lineages, sunids, homology_scope 'sf' and empty warnings verified in the bundle. Correctly states SCOPe asserts ancestry only within c.2.1, makes no cross-fold assertion, and does not prove convergence; names superposition, topology, profile/HMM and motif analysis as required external evidence. Covers convergence from chemical constraint, chance motifs, and loss/switch of cofactor in homologs. Limits on search pagination stated. No material issue.

Thorough: 2.04 fold difference, change first in 2.05, 2.08 shared superfamily b.18.1 with families b.18.1.36 vs b.18.1.3, superfamily common ancestry only, no function transfer. Correctly notes the premise is the collagen-binding domain, not the catalytic domain, and reports bounded structural windows honestly.

Complete reasoning: shared family in same release keeps homology; hf constrains structural reading rather than erasing the relationship; no template or superposition use without alignment/RMSD evidence; stratify or exclude d1ztra1 from fold-level tasks; mutant caveat; no quality ranking, no function transfer. Release 2.08 stable vs periodic update distinction, sunids, lineage, comments and hf fields all supported. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22. Extensive bundle-supported facts: lineage, protein/species nodes, fr flag semantics, family-level homology with no warnings, 45 protein children, quality for both entries (1uc6 NMR SPACI 0.0216; 1o5d X-ray 2.05 A SPACI 0.2875). Alignment: partial coverage reported, low coverage not read as weak membership, missing positions not deletions. Representative: exclude or stratify fragments; declines to rank by SPACI across different methods (overly cautious but not an error). Diversity counted as a fragment stratum. Limits clearly stated with no function/ligand/template transfer. Complete.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. New superfamily conditional on verified fold resemblance; family correctly nested and rejected; new superfamily makes no analogy/convergence claim; new fold contradicts premise and requires exhaustive comparison; one-member superfamily is a placement decision, not demonstrated origin; no function or template transfer. Release facts fully supported by bundled /releases/current.

Verified facts (superfamily 56112 in fold 56111, class d; families 88854, 64411, 56171 with the record's 'Phoshoinositide' spelling; complete children list; homology_implied_by_level with no warnings; curator comment) all match the bundle. Correctly identifies superfamily as the deepest homology-bearing level, notes fold alone would not establish ancestry, and treats the three as superfamily relatives rather than close homologs; mechanistic conclusion limited to a conserved PK-like phosphotransfer core labelled as general knowledge. Explicitly says substrate, chemistry and regulation cannot be transferred from superfamily or family placement, and that regulation depends on non-catalytic domains and partners. Required evidence: same-release target lineage, residue-level alignment with acceptor-pocket mapping, primary biochemical data, and full-length domain architecture with modification/interaction data. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-22.
